correctness.rationale: For each middle-bit pair bc, the endpoints a,d give a 2×2 probability block with both row and column sums h=1/8, so its two diagonal entries equal a free q_bc and its two off-diagonal entries equal h−q_bc. Reversal transposes the endpoints and swaps bc with cb. The equal-middle-bit blocks are invariant; the other two yield four linked reversal differences, up to sign, of J=q_01−q_10. Thus τ=4|J|<1/2. In the frozen coordinates x=q_01, the derivative of D4 has the sign of 2x−h−J for J≠0. It vanishes at the sole minimizing x=(h+J)/2, with the advertised 2τ artanh(2τ); the other two block parameters are free. For either sign of J the logarithmic cost diverges at the ends of the feasible open x-interval, and continuity yields every finite cost at or above the minimum. Positive transitions p4/h give an irreducible history chain with the uniform stationary law. Cancellation of the initial h and stationarity of each local quadruple give the exact D_n identity and reversibility when J=0. This is a population path-law statement. The origin is the only point at τ=0, not a topologically isolated point (the lower curve tends to it); RESULT states the former correctly. Nonzero arrow forces minimal Markov order three, since lower order with uniform triples forces IID fair bits, and the origin also has exact-order-three representatives by choosing q_00≠h/2 on J=0. Independent replay gave exact TV and normalization plus direct numerical KL block sums on 35 signed-current tables, including both signs, equality and the reversible case; it is finite corroboration, not proof.
residual_risks: Fairness concerns consecutive triples, and the rate is observed-path relative entropy rather than microscopic heat. The isolated-endpoint wording in ancillary material should be read only as uniqueness at zero arrow.

value.rationale: At the first observable word length for a binary time arrow, uniform triples remove all shorter-window signals. An exact characterization of what four-frame TV can certify about the information rate, when that certificate is tight and whether TV caps the rate at all, is useful beyond the general sharp KL inequality. The half-mass and one-current restrictions quantify a natural local-observation regime rather than an arbitrary numeric slice.
residual_risks: No physical dissipation calibration or finite-sample detection guarantee follows.
